articles.title: Kochetkov Named NHL's Third Star Of The Month
Predators Acquire Shane Wright From Kraken
Hurricanes players bring children to center ice for Kids Day Storm Surge

out.detail: Upper body injury; made the trip and participated in morning skate but will not play per coach Rod Brind'Amour

away.summary: The Hurricanes (12-2-2) are riding strong form and project to use the same forward and defensive groupings as their recent games. Taylor Hall is out despite participating in the morning skate, while Jordan Staal remains sidelined with a calf injury. Pyotr Kochetkov is the projected starter after a franchise-record 9-0-0 start to the season and October’s NHL Third Star honors.

home.summary: The Predators (5-4-5) are projected to start Juuse Saros in net. Shane Wright is expected to make his Predators debut after being acquired from Seattle for Matthew Wood. Nashville has multiple scratches, including Nicolas Hague, Ilya Lyubushkin, and Jonathan Marchessault, with Marchessault’s status uncertain as a game-time decision.
